scope_title: CM55 only - CM33_NS is a boot shim

scope_jobs.cm33_ns: boot shim: cybsp init, enable clocks the CM55 needs (GFXSS, SAR), start CM55, deep sleep - no console, no peripherals
scope_jobs.cm55: everything: console UART, peripherals, application logic

summary: scope cm55: CM33_NS boots CM55 and sleeps; the app (console + drivers) runs on CM55
source: Infineon ML examples run their app on CM55 with retarget-io there (e.g. mtb-example-psoc-edge-ml-deepcraft-deploy-vision proj_cm55/source/retarget_io_init.c)
notes: to implement: files/proj_cm33_ns/main.c boot shim; ai-kit-board switch BOARD_CONSOLE_ON_CM55 (skip SCB2 init); cm55-board console + millis; bsp drivers ported to proj_cm55 (cores [cm33_ns, cm55])
